selection: Select the two complete OpenAI configurations with highest development removal F1, then balanced accuracy, then model and prompt name. Use no held-out labels.
test: For each finalist rerun both partitions independently after shuffling inputs with each seed. Keep identical rubric, payload fields, model, effort and output schema. Report full-bank agreement with historical labels and item-level consistency with the original run. Repeats are a stability check and do not change the frozen selection rule.
